snippet.title: Lofelia's Cozy Corner – Gameplay Trailer
snippet.description: Meet Lofelia, your dreamy desktop companion who writes books as you work, study or game. In this cozy clicker game, every time you press a key Lofelia continues to write her stories. How will you decorate Lofelia's Cozy Corner?
